# ParlayPal — full product context

## What ParlayPal is

ParlayPal is a sportsbook-independent live bet companion. It reads a screenshot of a bet slip, extracts the teams, players, markets, lines, and combinations, lets the bettor review the result, then follows supported event data and builds a transparent outcome record.

ParlayPal is not a sportsbook or gambling operator. It does not accept wagers, hold funds, set odds, or guarantee outcomes. Users should follow local laws and gamble responsibly.

## Who it is for

ParlayPal is for sports bettors who want one readable view of a ticket after placing it. It is useful for player props, team markets, moneylines, spreads, totals, same-game combinations, and parlays that mix player and team selections.

## Workflow

1. Upload a screenshot or photo of a ticket from FanDuel, DraftKings, BetMGM, PrizePicks, or another sportsbook.
2. ParlayPal extracts the ticket and normalizes the event, player, team, market, line, direction, and period details.
3. Review and confirm the extracted legs before live tracking begins.
4. ParlayPal matches each leg to supported sports data and records progress snapshots.
5. Receive scheduled updates and milestone notifications through the channels enabled in account preferences.
6. Review settled tickets and personal hit-rate analytics by player, team, sport, market, and ticket size.

## Notification behavior

Notifications are designed to communicate meaningful ticket changes, not every raw feed event. A player prop can show current progress toward its line, such as a three-point or points-plus-rebounds-plus-assists total. A team moneyline or spread can show the current score and period or quarter. Final settlement notifications report whether a leg or full ticket won or lost. Delivery frequency depends on the user’s plan and selected interval; supported plans include scheduled five-minute or fifteen-minute live updates.

## Supported sports

- Football: NFL, NCAA football, international football. Track moneylines, spreads, totals, team markets, and supported passing, rushing, receiving, and touchdown props.
- Basketball: NBA, WNBA, NCAA basketball, international basketball. Track moneylines, spreads, totals, points, rebounds, assists, threes, and supported combo props.
- Baseball: MLB, MiLB, and international baseball. Track moneylines, run lines, totals, team markets, and supported hitter or pitcher props.
- Hockey: NHL, AHL, and international hockey. Track moneylines, puck lines, totals, and supported shots, points, or goals props.
- Soccer: Premier League, MLS, UEFA competitions, and international soccer. Track match result, goals totals, team markets, and supported player props.
- MMA: UFC, MMA events, and supported promotions. Track fight moneylines, method of victory, round totals, and supported fighter props.
- Tennis: ATP, WTA, Grand Slam events, and international tennis. Track match winners, set or game handicaps, totals, and supported player props.
- Racing: NASCAR, Formula 1, IndyCar, and global motorsport. Track winners, podiums, finishing positions, matchups, laps, stages, and supported race props.
- Golf: PGA Tour, LIV Golf, LPGA, and major championships. Track tournament winners, top finishes, player matchups, and supported round or tournament markets.

Availability can vary by sportsbook ticket, league, event, market, and live-data coverage. The user reviews extracted legs before tracking.

## Plans

- Free: $0 forever; five tracked tickets per month, fifteen-minute live updates, basic player hit rates, and in-app notifications.
- Pro: $12.99 monthly or $99.99 annually; 500 ticket uploads per month, five-minute live updates, player/team/market analytics, email game alerts, and priority processing.
- Creator: $24.99 monthly or $199 annually; 1,000 ticket uploads per month, bulk historical imports, highest-priority processing, creator analytics, and Pro features.

Current public pricing is listed at https://myparlaypal.com/pricing.md and on the homepage pricing section.
